title: Natural source boundary for supplied integral adjunctions
statement: For the six-functor datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum] and a closed immersion i:Z→X with complementary open j:U→X, X separated of finite type over the geometric field, the datum's integral counit j!j*→Id and unit Id→i*i* admit a natural connecting transformation after the full constructible inclusion into the completed derived category. For every bounded constructible input, this gives a distinguished triangle, and its connecting arrow is the unique arrow completing these two maps to a distinguished triangle. Empty strata are allowed. This is source recollement; no compact-support image or tower is asserted.

source.place: Clause (3): the recollement-image argument, source triangle and exact compact-support realization

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-package-integral-recollement-normalization] to the presentation made from the supplied open counit and closed unit. This identifies the actual two maps with the completed exact sheaf sequence without assuming any distinguished triangle or boundary.

Apply the proved integral_normalized constituent of [lem-sf-normalized-rational-recollement-triangles] to this normalized integral presentation. It gives distinguished completions and shifted cross-object Hom vanishing in the full constructible category. Map the triangles through the full exact inclusion; use its shift comparison and Hom bijections to transport the vanishing to the ambient derived category.

Choose one distinguished completion at every input, inside the proof. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-triangle-morphism-extension] and the shifted cross-object Hom vanishing to the inclusion of any input morphism: the naturality squares of the supplied unit and counit force the third square. Thus these arrows form a natural transformation. Apply the same theorem to the identity middle morphism to prove uniqueness of every component. This also covers empty strata.

proof_origin.place: Clause (3), source recollement; integral-stage adjunction and sheaf-sequence normalization in prop-sf-open-closed-triangle-all-stages.proof.md; Stacks 09AH and 015F.
proof_origin.note: Normalization of the two sheaf maps is isolated; distinguishedness, ambient Hom vanishing, uniqueness and naturality are implemented in Lean using the existing normalized integral constituent.

theorem sfPackageIntegralRecollementSource
    {Z U X : SixFunctorSpace D}
    [IsSeparated X.obj.hom]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left]
    (hj : IsOpenImmersion j.hom.left)
    (hij : Set.range j.hom.left.base = (Set.range i.hom.left.base)ᶜ) :
    ∃ d : (S.higher.integral.pull i ⋙ S.higher.integral.direct i) ⋙
        (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E X.obj.left).ι ⟶
      ((S.higher.integral.pull j ⋙ S.higher.integral.openExtension j hj) ⋙
        (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E X.obj.left).ι) ⋙ shiftFunctor _ (1 : ℤ),
      ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left,
        (Triangle.mk
          ((sfIntegralConstructible C.l E X.obj.left).ι.map
            ((S.higher.integral.openAdjunction j hj).counit.app K))
          ((sfIntegralConstructible C.l E X.obj.left).ι.map
            ((S.higher.integral.pullDirectAdjunction i).unit.app K))
          (d.app K) ∈ distTriang _) ∧
        ∀ d', Triangle.mk
          ((sfIntegralConstructible C.l E X.obj.left).ι.map
            ((S.higher.integral.openAdjunction j hj).counit.app K))
          ((sfIntegralConstructible C.l E X.obj.left).ι.map
            ((S.higher.integral.pullDirectAdjunction i).unit.app K))
          d' ∈ distTriang _ → d' = d.app K
